installations-upgrades.subtitle: Upgrade to the Latest Version of Clarity with Confidence
intro: Broadcom releases a new version of Clarity approximately every three months, introducing new features, customer-driven enhancements, performance improvements, security updates, and bug fixes. Staying current with the latest release allows organizations to continuously deliver greater value to users while benefiting from the latest innovations, enhanced performance, and ongoing product support.

Whether you're planning a fresh implementation or upgrading from an older version, Albatroz provides end-to-end Clarity installation and upgrade services that ensure a smooth, secure, and successful transition.

migration-to-modern-ux.subtitle: Accelerate Your Transition to the Clarity Modern UX
intro: Since Clarity version 16.0, Broadcom has positioned the Modern UX (MUX) as the primary platform for innovation, delivering nearly all new features, enhancements, and user experience improvements through the Modern interface.

Organizations still relying on the Classic UI should consider migrating to the Modern UX to leverage a more intuitive, collaborative, and user-friendly platform that improves productivity, enhances visibility, and drives higher user adoption across the enterprise.
Whether you're planning a complete migration or a phased transition, Albatroz provides end-to-end Modern UX migration services that ensure a seamless, low-risk, and business-focused transformation.

Improve user experience with a modern, intuitive interface

Improve visibility through modern dashboards, blueprints, and configurable views
Drive higher user adoption across the organization
Align with Broadcom's strategic product roadmap and future releases

integration.subtitle: Connect Clarity with Your Enterprise Ecosystem
intro: As organizations mature their Project Portfolio Management (PPM) processes and expand Clarity adoption across multiple business units, seamless integration with enterprise applications becomes essential.

Clarity often needs to exchange data with HR systems, ERP platforms, financial applications, Agile and ALM tools, IT service management solutions, procurement systems, and other enterprise applications. Effective integrations eliminate duplicate data entry, improve data accuracy, streamline business processes, and provide a unified view of project and portfolio information across the organization.
Whether you require real-time API integrations or high-volume batch processing, Albatroz delivers scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade Clarity integration solutions tailored to your business needs.

sections.subtitle: Enterprise integrations enable organizations to

Improve user adoption through connected business processes
